assertions: Lilly should and will purchase Master B.'s houses, including the Strand house he lives in: he will deal with the seller and the bargain will be concluded, not broken off.

The seller is tractable and the negotiation will perfect: Venus applying by trine to Saturn, lord of the 4th (the houses), and the lord of the 7th being also lord of the 11th (Lilly's hopes) show seller, property and Lilly's hopes coming together in agreement.

Completion comes with difficulty, haggling and delay rather than smoothly at once: the Moon translates light by a square, but out of signs of long ascension, so the square is mitigated and does not deny the matter.

The money difficulty is delay, not failure: Mercury, lord of Lilly's 2nd, retrograde matches his money not being callable for six months, but he will procure/recall the money in time to pay for the purchase, within that months-scale window (about six months) rather than in days.

The houses themselves are worth buying and not materially defective or ruinous: Saturn, lord of the 4th, has no material essential debility except retrogradation and cadency, so the property is old/slow to transfer but sound in substance.

The seller's first demand of £530 will not simply be paid instantly on first terms; dealing, waiting on the money, and the seller allowing the transaction to proceed to completion are part of the outcome.
method: Classical horary astrology (Lilly, Christian Astrology): 1st/2nd for querent and his money, 7th for seller, 4th for the houses, 11th for hopes; whole-sign/traditional significators as named in the figure notes.
reasoning: 本题应验跨度定为月档，依据为购房交易与钱款六个月才能收回的事实尺度。Seller significator Sun placed in the 7th and received by exalted Venus near the 7th cusp shows the seller well-disposed/received; lord of 7th also lord of 11th ties the seller to fulfilment of Lilly's hopes. Venus applying trine Saturn (lord 4th, the houses) is a perfection between seller-side and property by an easy aspect. Moon translating light by square out of signs of long ascension carries the matter through despite friction — Lilly's rule mitigates such a square. Mercury lord 2nd retrograde denies ready cash now but signifies money returning/being called in, matching the stated six-month delay, so payment is late but in time. Saturn lord 4th essentially undamaged apart from retrograde/cadent accidental weakness means the houses are sound, only the transfer is slow. No denying prohibition outweighs these perfections.
summary: He will buy Master B.'s houses: agreement with the seller will be reached and the money, though delayed about six months, will be procured in time to pay.
